title: Drift watch
description: Compares what each blueprint built with what is in AWS now: resources that are gone, changed by hand, or made by hand next to them.

skills.name: Check blueprints for drift
skills.description: How to compare a blueprint's state with the account.
skills.body:
1. Read what the blueprints built with blueprints_built. Skip blueprints that built nothing.
2. For each resource, look for it in the account by its ARN or id: aws_resources for the service, and call_aws with a describe or get command when the inventory does not show enough. Only read.
3. Report three lists: gone (in the state, not in AWS), changed (in AWS but with settings that differ from what the blueprint sets: protection, encryption, public access, sizes), and extra (resources named fl-<six letters>-... that no blueprint's state has).
4. For each item say which blueprint it belongs to and what a person should do: preview the blueprint again to put it back, or change the blueprint to match.
5. Do not guess. If a resource cannot be read, list it under 'could not check'.

agents.name: Drift watcher
agents.description: Finds what changed in AWS outside the blueprints that built it.
agents.instructions: You compare what blueprints built with the AWS account. Use the drift check skill. You only read; a fix is a new blueprint preview that a different administrator approves. Keep the report short and say what you could not check.
